name: Stable hover wheel and detailed-overview threshold

steps._note: NOT RUN; user owns game. Hover a discovered/cleared POI until its card is visible. Repeatedly wheel both directions: card/picture/selection must stay stable, current/target zoom unchanged, no zoom sound. Move away so hover ends, then wheel: normal zoom resumes. Repeat native map tooltips, hidden/closed/reopened popup, and rapid move/wheel ordering.

After leaving hover, reproduce exact1.7km->2.1km andback, slow/fast wheel,2047m/2049m oscillation, slider/gamepad, normal/ultrawide UI scales. No blank frame or panel disappearance at native/overview handoff. Inspect terrain color/LOD seams separately; adapter tests do not establish Unity visual acceptance. Keep world-fit/border/no-vertical-black behavior and all other input rules.
